metaDescription: Concrete Tillsonburg won Oxford County's 2026 Concrete Finishing award. See its 350+ pours, air-entrained mix and written warranty terms explained.
summary: Concrete Tillsonburg is Oxford County's concrete contractor for driveways, stamped patios and garage floors, with more than 350 completed projects over 12-plus years. Every mix is air-entrained and engineered specifically for the region's freeze-thaw cycles.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Concrete Tillsonburg pours and finishes custom concrete driveways, stamped patios and walkways, garage and basement floors, and also handles concrete repair and resurfacing of existing damaged surfaces. More than 350 completed projects over 12-plus years give the company deep, repeated exposure to Oxford County soil and weather conditions specifically, rather than broader regional experience alone.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: The company uses air-entrained concrete, a mix designed with microscopic air pockets that let the material expand and contract through repeated freezing and thawing without cracking, and reinforces every pour with rebar or wire mesh as standard rather than an upgrade. Every project is backed by a written warranty. This combination points to a company building for multi-decade durability rather than the lowest-cost pour.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One customer said a resurfacing job saved them thousands of dollars and looked completely new, with a clean job site and same-day completion. Another homeowner who had a stamped walkway installed with a decorative border said the pattern looks exactly like natural stone and praised the company's communication throughout.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Concrete Tillsonburg is based in Tillsonburg and serves the surrounding Oxford County region. Homeowners further afield should confirm coverage of their address before requesting a quote.

strengths: More than 350 completed projects and 12-plus years focused specifically on Oxford County conditions.
Uses air-entrained concrete, engineered to withstand repeated freeze-thaw cycling without cracking.
Rebar or wire mesh reinforcement is standard on every pour, not an optional add-on.
Every project is backed by a written warranty.
considerations: Focused on flatwork such as driveways, patios and floors rather than structural foundation work.
Resurfacing is a good option for existing concrete in fair condition but is not a fix for severely heaved or broken slabs.
Concrete pouring is weather-dependent, so scheduling tightens through spring and fall.
bestFor: Homeowners replacing a cracked driveway with a durable freeze-thaw mix
Anyone wanting a stamped walkway or patio with a decorative border
Resurfacing existing concrete instead of a full tear-out
Garage or basement floor pours in Tillsonburg and Oxford County
questionsToAsk: Is resurfacing suitable for my existing concrete, or does it need a full replacement instead?
What reinforcement is included in the quoted price, rebar or wire mesh?
What does the written warranty cover, and for how long?
How long should the concrete cure before it can handle vehicle traffic?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Concrete Tillsonburg was selected as the top business in the Concrete Finishing & Pouring category for Tillsonburg through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: Do they only pour new concrete?
faq.a: No. Alongside new driveways, patios and floors, the company offers concrete repair and resurfacing for existing damaged surfaces.

faq.q: What makes the concrete mix suitable for Ontario winters?
faq.a: The company uses air-entrained concrete, which is engineered to withstand repeated freeze-thaw cycles without cracking, reinforced with rebar or wire mesh as standard.
Concrete Tillsonburg is based in Tillsonburg and serves the surrounding Oxford County region, according to its listed service area.
